author: Taylor M.
body: I have been using the growth serum for a good few weeks now to help the thickness and growth of my lashes . It’s AMAZING .. can’t believe the growth In them . I apply it once a day . You can see the results for yourself once I gave myself a lash lift with Luxe cosmetics kit u can see the results … my lashes starts above the 6mm and have now grown to the 9mm . Would definitely recommend for anyone with short and thin lashes !! X

author: Louisa C.
body:
Luxe serum has made my lashes ridiculously long :)))
  
  I'm on my 4th bottle and have already bought 4 more.
  
  Not only does the product work great, but the customer service is beyond excellent. The best customer service I have ever experienced.

author: Kim F.
body: I tried many serums and finally ended up with this one, but you have to be consistent. I apply it daily before bedtime and it works great

author: Emilia L.
body:
I tried so many eyelash serums ... When I was done with my nerves, my head hurt 😬. There are so many of them. Who can you believe? Well, believe me!!! This stuff REALLY works (I don't work for this company nor was I paid for this review).
  
  Believe it or not, I actually get compliments from girls who have extensions for eyelashes. Come on... You have to agree with me... They look so fake. That's also the reason why I don't wear them. I even get compliments from men saying how beautiful my eyes are 🤭 At my doctor's office, his wife asked about my eyelashes.
  
  A long time ago I had single eyelashes glued. Ewww 😳 they stung and itched. After a few days they irritated me so much I started pulling them out.
  
  I apply it in the morning and just before bed. It has never irritated my eyelids.

author: Vera G.
body: My friend said my lashes looked longer and that was only after a month of consistent daily use of this lash serum. It's been about 7 weeks since I started using it and I love that my lashes look longer and even thicker. From my side, I really recommend the product to everyone; I am very happy with my results.

author: Emelie K.
body: I've been using the Luxe Lash Serum for over a year and couldn't be happier! I recently went to my beautician and she asked me if I had lengthened my lashes! Because that's how good they look! It's incredible! Combined with the Luxe Eyelash Lifting Set, they are so long! I can't recommend this product enough!

author: Anna L.
body: I love it. For the first week or two I didn't really notice anything, so I thought that like all the other products I see on Facebook ads, it was just a scam and didn't work. Well, I was very wrong about that. Even though I thought it wouldn't do anything, I've been doing it every night before bed and here's the data and results. I don't have to recommend it, just check it out for yourself.
